title: Core: AS2 while loop and for loop variations
description: Test compilation of: while(cond) { body }, for(init; cond; update) { body }, for(;;) { break; } (infinite loop), for(var i=0; i<10; i++) { if(i==5) continue; }, while(true) { break; }. Test that break/continue emit ActionJump (0x99). Test C-style for loop with no init/cond/update omitted. Verify loop opcodes ActionIf (0x9D) and ActionJump (0x99).
